definitions.explanation: The act of opening a sealed letter, package, or container. Used as a suru verb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開封|かいふう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{開封|かいふう}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{召|め}し{上|あ}がり→お召し上がり：26515_omeshiagari⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

{開封|かいふう}⟦{済|ず}み→〜済み：04013_zumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{返品|へんぴん}→返品：05465_henpin⟧⟦できません→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧でご⟦{了承|りょうしょう}→了承：11415_ryoushou⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please note that opened products cannot be returned.

notes:
FORMS:
{開|かい} (open) + {封|ふう} (seal). Literally "opening the seal."

USAGE:
Commonly seen on product labels, food packaging, and in online shopping contexts. Used as a suru verb: {開封|かいふう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to open/unseal).
Product labels often say {開封|かいふう}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{召|め}し{上|あ}がり→お召し上がり：26515_omeshiagari⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧ (please consume promptly after opening). In e-commerce, ⟦{未開封|みかいふう}→未開封：10677_mikaifuu⟧ items can typically be returned, while {開封|かいふう}⟦{済|ず}み→〜済み：04013_zumi⟧ items often cannot.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開封|かいふう}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧: after opening
- {開封|かいふう}⟦{済|ず}み→〜済み：04013_zumi⟧: already opened
- ⟦{未開封|みかいふう}→未開封：10677_mikaifuu⟧: unopened, still sealed
- {開封|かいふう}⟦{厳禁|げんきん}→厳禁：18021_genkin⟧: do not open

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {封|ふう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ / {封|ふう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とじる: to seal (the opposite action)
